Name: Secondary Keybind
Author: quan2808
Description:
[center][heading][left]Secondary Keybind[/left]
[/heading]
[/center]
Add secondary keybindings and customizable mouse button support for movement, basic actions, menus, and hotbar slots in [i]Stardew Valley[/i].
[b]Arrow keys are set as secondary movement keys by default[/b], alongside the original WASD keys.
[heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] (Required)[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (Required)[/*]
[/list][heading]Installation[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Download and extract Secondary Keybind.[/*]
[*]Copy the mod folder into your
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]directory.[/*]
[*]Launch the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][heading]Usage & Configuration[/heading]
Press
[code]Esc[/code]→ [b]Options[/b] → [b]Secondary Keybind[/b] to customize your keybindings.
Alternatively, edit the mod's
[code]config.json[/code]file manually.
